pictures.name: SD1-Abitinae-Dawn
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Dawn in a small Roman North African town around 300 AD: whitewashed and sandstone houses, palm trees, a dusty lane. A few ordinary Christians, men and women in simple wool tunics and cloaks, slip quietly through a half-open wooden door into a house, glancing over their shoulders. Pale gold sunrise, long deep blue shadows. The doorway in the middle. Quiet, brave, secret. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: SD2-House-Mass
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Inside a modest North African house around 300 AD, a low room lit by oil lamps: about forty ordinary people, men and women of many ages, stand and kneel around a simple wooden table with a round loaf of bread and a cup of wine. An older priest with a grey beard in a plain white tunic lifts the bread, seen from the side. Emeritus, a calm middle-aged North African man with short dark hair and a short beard, in a plain off-white wool tunic and brown cloak, stands among them with his hands open. Warm gold lamplight on faces, deep blue shadows. The table and bread in the middle. Holy, close, joyful. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: SD3-Soldiers-At-Door
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The doorway of the same North African house in early morning. Two Roman soldiers in red cloaks and helmets stand at the open door, stern but not violent. The Christians walk out calmly in a line, heads up, holding each other’s hands; Emeritus, a calm middle-aged North African man with short dark hair and a short beard, in a plain off-white wool tunic and brown cloak, leads them. Gold morning light on their faces, deep blue shadow in the lane. The doorway in the middle. Calm courage, dignity, no fear. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: SD4-Before-Governor
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A Roman basilica hall in Carthage around 304 AD: a Roman governor in a white toga with a purple border sits on a raised chair under marble columns, frowning and leaning forward. Before him stands Emeritus, a calm middle-aged North African man with short dark hair and a short beard, in a plain off-white wool tunic and brown cloak, calm and upright, one hand on his chest, answering. Behind him the group of Christians waits quietly. A shaft of gold light through a high window falls on Emeritus, deep blue shadows in the hall. Emeritus in the middle. Steady, gentle, unafraid. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: SD5-Without-Sunday
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A plain stone room in Carthage with one small high barred window. The group of Christians, Emeritus, a calm middle-aged North African man with short dark hair and a short beard, in a plain off-white wool tunic and brown cloak, among them, sits close together on the floor, praying with peaceful faces, hands joined. A single beam of gold sunlight falls through the window onto them. Deep blue shadows, gentle gold light. The group in the middle. Peace, faithfulness, hope. No injury, gentle and calm. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: SD6-Today-Sunday-Table
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A modern family Sunday afternoon, painted in the same sacred oil style: a long table in a sunny backyard with a big shared lunch, three generations laughing together, a grandfather pouring lemonade, a phone lying face down on the table. In the distance behind them, a church steeple with a bell. Warm gold afternoon light, deep blue shade under a tree. The table in the middle. Rest, joy, family, unhurried time. No text, no letters, no logos.
